notes.title: Bundle! Two Amazing Platformers!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48383/Agent_Brain_Tricky_Puzzles_x_JustAxe/

Now you can grab a bundle of two exciting games — Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles and JustAxe — with a 50% discount on the total price.

Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles is an innovative puzzle platformer that will make you think outside the box. Each level offers unique solutions, breaking the boundaries between game and player. You’ll use mechanics like gravity control, drone piloting, car driving, jetpack flying, and more. Plus, the game is packed with secrets for the curious.

JustAxe is a thrilling 2D platformer with puzzles and an interactive environment in a unique setting. Set in a distant future on Earth, the small town of Novye Sovety is under attack by beings from another dimension. Armed with her ancestor’s battle axe, the heroine embarks on a dangerous journey to save her sister—and humanity. Players will explore diverse locations, from forests and mountains to eerie alien dimensions, solving puzzles and interacting with their surroundings.

Don't miss the chance to add these amazing games to your collection at a fantastic price!

notes.title: Level 46 collision fix
notes.notes:
In the last update, we accidentally added an invisible collision just before the end of the level, which blocked its completion.

This problem has now been fixed.

notes.title: ⭐ First week! Thank you!
notes.notes:
It's already been a week since the release of Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles! 🎉

We are incredibly happy to see that the game is bringing you joy and fun!

🙏 A huge thank you to everyone who played the game, and an even bigger thanks to those who left a review — it really helps the game's visibility with Steam's algorithms! ⭐

🐞 Fortunately, no bugs have been found so far, but there have still been a few updates this week:

[list]
[*] The level select menu now shows where you've found secrets.
[*] Some levels have been slightly adjusted to improve their design and flow.
[*] A few small visual changes have been made.
[/list]

👀 Be sure to keep following the project — there will be both major and minor updates, with new levels and secrets on the way! 🚀

notes.title: 🎉 Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles has finally been released!
notes.notes:
🎉 We are excited to announce that Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles has finally been released!

If you enjoy games that break the usual rules and make you think outside the box, Agent Brain: Tricky Puzzles is definitely for you! Expect tricky traps, unique challenges, and plenty of fun moments that will troll you and entertain you at the same time.

Ready to take on the challenge? Purchase the game and share your impressions! 🔍
